classification.notes: Article describes a Long-Term Stock Exchange rule change amending its Clearly Erroneous Executions rule (Rule 11.270) in light of overnight protected bands for 23/5 trading. This is an exchange-internal rule filing with no direct risk angle touching any DTCC process described in the card catalog. While 23/5 trading is tangentially related to extended-hours settlement (ECS-SET-01), this article is only about erroneous execution bands at LTSE — not a settlement cycle change, market disruption, or other Step 1 event covered by any card.
